listing.name: The Elder Scrolls: Arena / OpenTESArena
listing.summary: Create a character and explore Arena’s opening dungeon with OpenTESArena and the original game files.

steps.title: Get Arena’s original game data
steps.instruction: OpenTESArena checks for an installed Steam copy of Arena and also checks for GOG on Windows. For manual setup, get Arena from https://elderscrolls.bethesda.net/en-US/arena. Open Arena106Setup.zip and extract Arena106.exe as a RAR archive with a tool that supports it. Keep the complete ARENA folder and your original archive.

steps.title: Start the Windows or Linux package
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Windows x64 ZIP or Linux x86-64 archive. For manual setup, copy ARENA into the player’s data folder. Start otesa.exe on Windows or run ./run.sh from the extracted Linux folder. Linux needs glibc 2.34 or newer, libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.30 and a Vulkan driver. Keep the supplied libraries beside the player.

steps.title: Use the Apple Silicon app
steps.instruction: On Apple Silicon with macOS 15.5 or later, copy otesa.app from the DMG. For manual game data setup, open Show Package Contents and put ARENA under Contents/Resources/data. Keep the app’s supplied libraries together.

warnings: In OpenTESArena 0.18.0, selecting a slot in Save Game or Load Saved Game shows Not implemented. Keep your original Arena saves for the player that created them.

references.title: Use the separate Raspberry Pi build
references.instruction: The upstream release has a Raspberry Pi 5 archive with a 32-bit ARM hard-float executable. Use a compatible Pi userland with the required libraries and Vulkan support, then follow the Linux original-data layout and run.sh instructions. The release supplies no Intel Mac build or Android APK.

references.title: Keep your OpenTESArena settings
references.instruction: Close the game before backing up options-changes.txt. Look in %APPDATA%/OpenTESArena/options on Windows, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/OpenTESArena/options or ~/.config/OpenTESArena/options on Linux, and ~/Library/Preferences/OpenTESArena/options on Mac. Keep your original game files and optional music patches separately. You manage runtime replacement using the upstream package.
